rationale: The repeated step and reversal response establishes a bounded effect of the priority setting on measured delay. It does not identify intake scheduling as the unique internal cause. The mapping explicitly excludes identification of internal stages and establishment of a unique cause.

signal_basis.exact_text: Each of three repetitions settles from five hours to three hours after the step and returns to five hours after reversal.
No other input changes or disturbances occur during these observations.
The observations identify neither internal stages nor behavior at other operating points; they do not establish a unique cause or zero remaining delay.
